Card.description: The surface for one visual. A Card inside a Card renders as a titled section.

Stack.description: Lays out its children in a column, or in a row.

Grid.description: Lays out its children in one to three columns. It collapses to one column on narrow screens.

example.text: A recorded zero and a day without a reading appear separately.

Callout.description: A note set apart from the prose. Use the caution or critical tone for warnings.

example.title: Missing day
example.message: No reading was available for Thursday.

Metric.description: A headline number with its label and unit. data is an optional sparkline in which null is a missing reading.

Progress.description: Progress toward a goal, drawn as a bar or a ring.

List.description: A list of ListItem children with an optional title.

ListItem.description: One row of a List, with an optional trailing value.

Steps.description: Numbered steps to follow in order, each with an optional duration.

Comparison.description: Two or three options side by side, row by row. winner is the zero-based index of the better column.

BarChart.description: Bars for a daily or categorical series. A null or missing y value is a missing reading, drawn differently from a recorded zero.

example.title: Daily steps
example.dayBoundary: Days run midnight to midnight UTC.

LineChart.description: A line for a series over time, with an optional goal line and target range band. A null y value is a gap.

MacroBreakdown.description: Calories with carbohydrate, protein and fat grams for one meal or one day.

RiskMeter.description: A low, medium or high risk verdict with its reason.

example.label: Blood sugar spike
example.detail: White rice on its own digests quickly.

Segmented.description: Switches what a visual shows. Bind value to a /ui path with $bindState and give each switched element a visible condition on that path.

Disclosure.description: Detail tucked behind a title until it is opened.

Checklist.description: Items the person can tick off during this session. Bind checked to a /ui path with $bindState.

Button.description: A tap target. Put its action in the on.press field of the element.

SuggestionChips.description: Up to four follow-ups the person can tap after reading the reply.

sendMessage.description: Sends the text as the person’s next message, exactly as if they had typed it.

openDestination.description: Opens Snap (photo logging), Log (the logbook) or Sync (health sync).

openLink.description: Opens an https page outside the chat.

pushState.description: Appends a value to an array under /ui.

removeState.description: Removes the item at index from an array under /ui.
